payload.rationale: M-ONLY LOCK (J CONTAMINATED — see contamination_notes). M is calibrated Elo->1x2 (predict_1x2, neutral symmetrized) at d_eff=+225. France Elo #3, tournament favorite (Opta ~31% to win, 44.7% to reach the final), but a BIG-FAVORITE + CROSS-CONTINENTAL case where the calibrated map is at its coarsest. Process is split: France's RESULTS are elite (14 goals) but hugely finishing-inflated (+5.8 over ~8 xG, the tournament's biggest overperformer; the R16 was a 1-0 grind with almost no open-play creation, no first-half shot on target) — their one repeatable strength is the best xG-defense (~0.76 xGA/g). Morocco (Elo #11, 2022 semifinalist who beat Spain+Portugal) is a genuine top side analysts think Elo may still UNDERrate, but their R16 3-0 flattered them (xG near-even 0.85-0.78). M outputs France 64.6% / draw 22.2% / Morocco 13.2%. NOTE the two competing distortions that make the M-market gap direction genuinely uncertain here: (a) 'Elo overrates big favorites' (pilot, m95) pushes France's true number DOWN; (b) 'Elo/market may underrate Morocco's pedigree' is cross-continental (error bars widen, direction unpredictable per doctrine). Neither is tradeable.

contamination_notes.method: M-ONLY lock. The evidence-pack subagent VIOLATED the odds firewall: in its odds_exposure declaration it wrote an actual market-implied number (a Kalshi prediction-market figure, 'France 62%') instead of only noting that a price leaked. The locking analyst therefore saw a market-implied France probability BEFORE locking -> J's independence is unrecoverable (por_esp precedent, PROTOCOL 2026-07-06). No j field: manufacturing a 'J' after seeing France~62% would be a fake independent prediction, exactly what the experiment guards against.
contamination_notes.impact: Match scores in B1-M only (M is provably price-blind arithmetic: Elo + situational facts from the CLEAN first subagent, committed pre-leak). EXCLUDED from B2 (no paper bet). J arm cannot reach 16 (adds to por_esp M-only, m92 MISSING) -> score.py §4 J-arm formal verdict remains on the reduced set. Declared, not hidden.
contamination_notes.process_fix: Future evidence-pack subagent prompts must state explicitly: NEVER write the numeric value of any leaked price/probability, not even in the odds_exposure list — record only the URL and a non-numeric slug. The m99/m98 subagents complied ('a price leaked, not reported'); this one did not.
